title: UX26 preflight: align F01/F03/F05 fixtures with their actor tasks
body:
## Outcome
Prepare faithful fixtures for T01, T03 and T05 before treating the full variants as ready.

## Delivery
Status: Closed (completed), 8 November 2026, on Nissan's instruction. All acceptance met on `main` `0a7d9a6` (table above). The remaining work is in open follow-ups: re-checking fixture readiness at the merged build in **#27**, and the T03/T05 continuity finding in **#45**.
Previous status (superseded 8 November 2026): Backlog — readiness remediation, not dispatched
Priority: P0 for the affected #26 variants
Evidence: source-inspected preflight at `d3f54e887fb946bccf399f142791ed87e6be1b76`, independently checked by a fresh Codex verifier. No actor actions, screenshots or user-observed failure are claimed.
Run: `ux26-20261106`, resumed 7 November 2026.
Severity: high readiness impact; evidence class is source inspection, not observed UX.

## Reproduction and mismatch
1. Compare `research/synthetic-ux/facilitator/evaluator-guide.md:17,19,21` with `apps/api/fixtures/corpus.json`.
2. F01 and F03 require unresolved matched contribution. The corpus has no corresponding claim/condition.
3. T03 asks about Round A2. Its topic has `sequence: []` (corpus lines 160–176). The sourced/editorial sequence is in a different support topic (211–214). Sending the actor to that different question cannot silently satisfy the A2 task.
4. T05 places the founder in Gympie. F05 intentionally excludes Gympie's local coverage and requires a static directory. The corpus instead covers QLD/national and offers a regional QLD hub. The builder's different-state workaround changes the actor's facts. No static directory was identified in the current UI.

References: [fixture oracle](https://github.com/nissan/oz-startup-brain/blob/d3f54e887fb946bccf399f142791ed87e6be1b76/research/synthetic-ux/facilitator/evaluator-guide.md), [corpus](https://github.com/nissan/oz-startup-brain/blob/d3f54e887fb946bccf399f142791ed87e6be1b76/apps/api/fixtures/corpus.json), [builder handoff](https://github.com/nissan/oz-startup-brain/blob/d3f54e887fb946bccf399f142791ed87e6be1b76/research/synthetic-ux/facilitator/build-25-fixture-ui.md).

## Acceptance
- Author fictional fixture states matching the existing actor facts and evaluator criteria, with source/claim/date/rights provenance, or explicitly review and version a smaller task scope before running it.
- Do not coach actors with canonical queries, expected outcomes or different jurisdictions.
- Any task/oracle change receives the required semantic mapping review; do not automatically rewrite the scenario-review checkpoint.
- Record per-variant fixture/readiness evidence on the revised pinned build.
- Demonstrate the actual UI path with isolated browser contexts before marking runtime capabilities present.
- Keep synthetic fixtures out of the production corpus and held-out evaluation set.

Refs #26. This is a preflight blocker, not a completed #27 browser finding or a product-fix dispatch.

## Reconciliation against merged #47–#49 — 8 November 2026
By Claude (`claude-reconcile-20261108`) on Nissan's instruction. Verified on `main` at `0a7d9a6` from a fresh clone ([evidence](https://github.com/nissan/oz-startup-brain/issues/23#issuecomment-6714202965); builder-run, not independent). Nothing was rebuilt.

| Acceptance | Outcome |
| --- | --- |
| Fictional fixtures match actor facts and evaluator criteria, with provenance | Done in `apps/api/fixtures/corpus.json` (`fixture-2026-11-07.1`): an unresolved matched-contribution claim and condition (F01/F03); a sourced and editorial A2 sequence that leaves out the future security requirement (T03); a Gympie outside-coverage topic with a static fictional directory (F05); a university-contact source. API regressions are in `scenarios.spec.ts` |
| No coaching | Done: `409d327..0a7d9a6` changes no brief, task, persona or evaluator-guide file. Off-topic subject words were narrowed in review so they abstain |
| Semantic mapping review for task/oracle changes | Not applicable: no task or oracle changed |
| Per-variant readiness on the revised build | Recorded on the reviewed candidate `8c3eaee8` (#48 `followup/`). The merged head differs slightly (shorter A2 labels, narrower matching), so the **re-check at the merged build belongs to #27's verification**, together with the #45 retest |
| Real UI path shown with isolated browser contexts | Done on the candidate: T01 (exact brief rerun), T03 and T05 fresh actors (#48) |
| Fixtures kept out of the production corpus | Done: only `apps/api/fixtures`; `data/sources` untouched |

The T03/T05 follow-up context loss found while running these fixtures is product finding **#45**, not part of this issue.
